discourse.title: Play the game
discourse.excerpt: Plant the seeds of Love in your hearts, let them grow into trees of service and shower the sweet fruits of Anandha.
discourse.theme: The birthday to celebrate is the message growing within: seeds of love becoming trees of service bearing the fruits of bliss.

reflection: Swami reframes celebration itself: the Avathar's birthday is celebrated when His message is born, grows and bears fruit in your own heart — love planted, grown into service, showering bliss on others. Today, plant one seed: one act of love that asks nothing back, and let it grow. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 15, 23 Nov 1972; nearest November discourse — no discourse dated 30 November appears in the corpus)

bhajan.title: Bhaja Sai Natham Bhaja Sai Natham Sai Natham Bhajarey Manasa

seva_nudge: Close the month by planting one seed of love that grows into service — volunteer an hour, share a meal, or help a neighbour without being asked.
